_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT (operator-directed) + A.1b
OBJECTIVE: Three priorities after the synthesis check: A repair the scientific join a note assembled from two faithfully carried sentences; B reduce the administrative startup context; C remove duplicated content between artefacts and phases. Preserve sources, caveats, coverage and independent verification.
why_here: the synthesis check drove absent caveats to zero and still let through a distortion of the class it declares it cannot see: the note joined DL-METH-081's wild-type values to the dossier's 'than Brca1-only controls', a label belonging to two other values. Both sentences were carried verbatim. The join was the defect.

case_reconstructed.values: ~0.123 -> ~0.027 (53BP1) and ~0.008 -> ~0.052 (RAD51), from DL-METH-081, discovery_ledger_current.md:2181, which describes Fig 2 and names NO comparator
case_reconstructed.comparator_label: 'than Brca1-only controls', from fulltext_dossiers/PMID38499540.md section 2, where it is paired with 0.115/0.027 and 0.014/0.051
case_reconstructed.relation: SAME experiment (Fig 2A/2B of one PMID), two descriptions quoting DIFFERENT baseline arms - wild type in the ledger, Brca1-only in the dossier. Not different experiments; not interchangeable.
case_reconstructed.scientific_consequence: against wild type the measured effect confounds Wwox loss with Brca1 loss, which is the confound the reading chose its control to remove

A_the_join.protection: comparison_check.py level 3: every note sentence presenting a measured value and a comparator as ONE comparison is checked for a single source sentence attesting them TOGETHER. Six verdicts; ASSEMBLED ACROSS SOURCES and ATTESTED ONLY BY A SENTENCE THAT WARNS fail; COMPARATOR/VALUE NOT IN THE SOURCES and NOT AUDITED report and do not fail, because a paraphrase and an invention are the same to a word match. A cross-experiment join may be declared - with a marker AND an address.
A_the_join.stated_limit: REFERENCE, not experimental equivalence. It does not say which value belongs to which arm - the same green row is returned for an assignment and its inverse - and it cannot see a unit swap. Printed in the command's own output and in the standing brief.

B_startup_surface.method: every term removed from a description was checked present in that skill's own SKILL.md body first; nothing was deleted, only not repeated at startup
B_startup_surface.expectation_set: skill_description_census.py TRIGGERS, written BEFORE the change: per skill the terms without which it cannot be chosen, and the terms belonging to a neighbour. It caught a pre-existing boundary violation (the sweep described itself with intake-triage's word 'deduplicated') and three triggers dropped on the first pass of rewrites
B_startup_surface.verification_is_static_not_behavioural: it establishes that each description still names what distinguishes it. It does NOT establish that a model asked to do X still selects skill X. No runtime selection comparison was run; the mandate forbade a new agent campaign to measure startup. The command says so in its own output.
B_startup_surface.characters_never_tokens: a per-component token count cannot be observed from inside a session and no conversion was applied

C_duplication.candidate_1: the same artefact path repeated on every locator row of a handoff packet: 884-1250 characters per packet, 2-3 percent. NOT removable - 4, 14 and 6 distinct paths across 28, 34 and 23 rows; the path is per-row information that happens to repeat
C_duplication.candidate_2: the record list carried by BOTH the packet's discovery and the facts block the note pastes: 14 of 14, 9 of 9, 30 of 30 - complete duplication. NOT removable - two artefacts with two audiences; a reader of the note has no packet
C_duplication.candidate_3: retraction_check and the reading debts in both the packet's mandated blocks and the facts block: same reason
C_duplication.outcome: no duplication found that can be removed without weakening the path, which is the outcome the mandate names for that case. One drift test added instead of a layer: the packet and the facts block derive the record list from one selector, and that they agree on identifiers AND digests is pinned rather than trusted
C_duplication.the_46_percent: the note-length cost measured 2026-09-12 is the caveats the note now quotes, not a duplication; removing it would mean removing them

delegations.budget: two new instances, one active at a time, no recursion - respected
delegations.both_conformant: session_model_census.py exit 0 on both transcripts: one model throughout. Neither run is a context comparison and neither is offered as one.

defects_found_by_the_blind_readers_and_r: the comparator object ended at any period, so a numeric object left the whole sentence unaudited - and a numeric object is the corpus's dominant idiom, 24 occurrences
content_words' three-character floor made wt, ko and ev the same word: three contradictory assignments, one green row
a table row is a whole block, so no comparison inside a table could ever be attested
presence alone attested a join, so an inverted assignment went green on the one sentence warning about that inversion
a count was not a measurement, so 0/9 against 4/13 - a paper's central claim - was outside the audit
a comparator the sources never use failed the check, flagging a faithful paraphrase, a faithful Italian note and correct arithmetic
the lookahead refusing a DOI also refused a full stop, so the LAST measurement of every sentence was invisible
a comparator with no parseable measurement emitted no row at all - the commonest English word order for a comparison
the ladder tested the missing value before the assembled join, so INVENTING A NUMBER TURNED A FAILING NOTE INTO A PASSING ONE
the declaration escape was a bare string match: 'The join declared here is obviously fine.' suppressed a real distortion, invisibly
the header pairing walked the split sentences, so it PRINTED AS EVIDENCE A SENTENCE ABSENT FROM THE FILE IT CITED, and welded two adjacent tables
the warning rule used the whole caveat-marker list, so a note restating a dossier sentence WORD FOR WORD was failed
defects_accepted_as_limits: a unit collision - the same number meaning grams in one row and cells per microlitre in another - is invisible to a string match; printed as a limit
ATTESTED ONLY BY A SENTENCE THAT WARNS fires on the correct assignment as well as on the inverted one; it directs attention, it does not adjudicate
also_repaired_while_building: _protect substituted the abbreviation list as SUBSTRINGS, so every sentence ending in 'resolution.', 'group.', 'specific.' or 'behav.' was welded to the next one. It degraded level 2 as well: a caveat merged with the sentence after it is matched against the note as one string.
tests: test_comparison_check.py 81 cases, expectations FIXED BY HAND - no test calls the tool's own splitter, tokeniser or caveat classifier to decide what it should have found. test_skill_description_census.py 6 cases. 23 mutations, each red.

checks.battery: 110 suites; the two declared reds test_batch_queue and test_surface_census unchanged and not weakened; one suite enrolled

DEFAULTS_TAKEN: Phase C delivered as a measurement and a drift test rather than a removal, because the measurement refuted the premise that a removable duplication existed.
The second delegation spent on a blind re-test of the repairs rather than on exploration; it found six more defects, two of them severe.
The skill descriptions verified statically only; stated as a missing proof rather than inferred over.
A first mutation battery was invalidated by two concurrent runs writing the same file and was re-run serially; six anchors were later dropped as superseded by the repairs they targeted.
remote: nothing pushed. origin and development resolve to one URL and origin is the operator's alone (21d).
